content: संधा €3 <ab>U.</ab> ²1 To join, bring together, unite, combine, put together, compound, mix; यानि उदकेन संधीयन्ते तानि भक्षणीयानि <ls>Kull.</ls> .²2 .³({%a%}) To treat with, form friendship or alliance with, make peace with; शत्रुणा न हि संदध्यात् सुश्लिष्टेनापि संधिना <ls>H. 1. 88</ls>; <ls>Chāṇ. 19</ls>; <ls>Kām. 9. 41</ls>. .³({%b%}) To unite in friendship, reconcile, make a friend of; सकृद्दुष्टमपीष्टं यः पुनः संधातुमिच्छति <ls>Pt. 2. 33</ls>. .²3 To fix upon, direct towards; संदधे दृशमुदग्रतारकाम् <ls>R. 11. 69</ls>. .²4 To fit to or place upon the bow (as a missile, arrow <ab>&c.</ab>); धनुष्यमोघं समधत्त बाणम् <ls>Ku. 3. 66</ls>; <ls>R. 3. 53</ls>, <ls n="R.">12. 97</ls>. .²5 To produce, cause; पर्याप्तं मयि रमणीयडामरत्वं संधत्ते गगनतलप्रयाणवेगः <ls>Māl. 5. 3</ls>; संधत्ते भृशमरतिं हि सद्वियोगः <ls>Ki. 5. 51</ls>. .²6 To hold out against, be a match for; शतमेकोऽपि संधत्ते प्राकारस्थो धनुर्धरः <ls>Pt. 1. 229</ls>. .²7 To mend, repair, heal. .²8 To inflict upon. .²9 To grasp, support, take hold of. .²10 To grant, yield. .²11 To make good, atone for. .²12 To contract, close up. .²13 To approach, come near. .²14 To prepare, make, compose. .²15 To assist, aid. .²16 To comprehend, conceive. .²17 To possess, have. .²18 To perform, do; स्वलीलया संदधतेऽव्ययात्मने <ls>Bhāg. 7. 8. 41</ls>; वाङ्मात्रेणापि साहाय्यं मित्रादन्यो न संदधे <ls>Pt. 2. 12</ls>. .²19 To employ, make use of, apply to use.

संधा .²1 Union, association. .²2 Intimate union, close connection. .²3 State, condition. .²4 An agreement, a promise, stipulation, compact; ततार संधामिव सत्यसंधः <ls>R. 14. 52</ls>; <ls>Mv. 7. 8</ls>. .²5 Limit, boundary; यन्नस्त्वं कर्मसंधानां साधूनां गृहमेधिनाम् <ls>Bhāg. 6. 5. 42</ls>. .²6 Fixity, steadiness. .²7 Twilight. .²8 Distillation (for संधान <ab>q. v.</ab>). .²9 Steady continuance in any state.
